experiment.hypothesis: A 10-hour consecutive uptrend in BTC-USD hourly close prices is followed by a reversal (downward move) in the next hour, with at least a 5% drop relative to the last uptrend close.

test.note: No misleading proxy: hypothesis requires unavailable inputs or rule expression.

experiment.falsification_test: For each 10-hour consecutive upward movement in BTC-USD hourly close prices, verify whether the next hour's close is at least 5% lower than the last uptrend close.
